correction_reason: V4 retains V3 official-source, annual-air-mass, C/E/M/U and kg/year normalization gates and additionally rejects permit performance or consumption contexts such as fuel, AdBlue, storage, capacity, operating hours, monitoring intervals and permit concentrations.
success_requirements: source is explicitly UK PRTR or Environment Agency Pollution Inventory
target facility or operator identity is present
numeric release value is finite and non-negative
release unit is a recognised annual kilogram tonne or gram mass unit
raw release value and unit are preserved for audit
accepted release is normalized to canonical kg/year
calculated estimated measured and unspecified official determination methods are valid
fuel or reagent usage storage capacity operating hours monitoring intervals performance parameters permit limits design concentrations transfers non-air media and non-mass units are rejected
missing or below-threshold data remains NO_DATA and is never inferred as zero
accepted output remains a facility annual air-release value and is never promoted to parcel value without verified geometry
